messages:
sam (pm): Proposal: bundle small migrations into 'batch windows' to reduce churn on infra and give customers predictable migration dates. Sketch: weekly small-batch (<= 10 models) and monthly large-batch (major families). Need thumbs on ops cost, customer impact, and gating.
rina (eng): Agree on bundling. Engineering benefit: fewer rollout cycles, more stable kernel tuning per batch. Risk: increases blast radius if gating is loose. Recommend stricter gates for batch >5 models.
owen (sre): Ops perspective: batch windows help scheduling but require stricter automation: auto-rollbacks, canary isolation per model, and cross-model resource reservation. Propose reserve 20% extra GPU headroom on batch days.
julia (support): Customer side: prefer predictability. Ask to publish a 30d migration calendar and a per-tenant "migration freeze" toggle (e.g., before big product launches). Also pinned customers should be excluded by default unless they opt in.
ben (data): For gating we need aggregated cohort metrics and drift summaries. Suggest pre-batch analytics: 1) eval regression distribution across models, 2) p95 latency delta, 3) token-cost skew per tenant. If >X% of models show regressions, abort batch.
sam (pm): Proposed policy: small-batch (weekly): max 10 models, each model must pass lightweight bench + 48h shadow + 3d canary at 1%-5%. Large-batch (monthly): max 50 models, require full bench + 7d shadow + staged ramps.
rina (eng): Automation snippet for pre-batch gate:
```
batch_gate:
  min_pass_rate: 0.90  # 90% of models must pass gates
  per_model_gates:
    - eval_delta_abs: 0.03
    - p95_latency_rel: 0.20
    - error_rate_abs: 0.005
  abort_if:
    - global_eval_fail_pct: 0.10
    - infra_pressure_pct: 0.15
```
ojulia (support): Will craft customer communications: calendar + per-model notice 10 days prior + reminder 48h before. Also provide a one-click postpone for enterprise admins.
owen (sre): Runbook additions: 1) create per-batch incident channel, 2) pre-reserve fallback pool (previous pinned variants), 3) run synthetic evals every 6h during ramp.
ben (data): Metric to watch: "batch_heatmap": rows=models, cols=tenants, value=eval-delta; highlight top 1% regressions and top 1% cost increases.
ship-bot: scheduled: `batch-run 5400001234 --window weekly-small --models 8 --policy batch_policy_v2` :rocket:
sam (pm): Decision items this sprint: - approve batch sizes & cadence (product+ops) - finalize min_pass_rate and abort rules (eng+data+sre) - calendar + postpone UI (prod+support+console). Aim for pilot next Monday.
rina (eng): I'll implement batch gate tooling and the per-model isolation. ETA: 1 sprint.
owen (sre): I'll add capacity reservations and pre-batch alerting.
julia (support): I'll prepare the templates and postpone toggle; need legal signoff for automatic credits.
ben (data): I'll build the batch_heatmap and an aggregated pass-rate report.
sam (pm): One more policy question: pinned customers — default exclude, but we can offer an "opt-in bulk migration" where pinned customers get a 14d extra grace. Thoughts?
rina (eng): Excluding by default is safest. Opt-in bulk migration ok if explicit consent.
owen (sre): Agreed. Also ensure opt-in pins are recorded in audit logs and included in pre-batch dry-run.
sam (pm): Great. If no objections I'll post the pilot checklist and schedule the pilot batch for next Mon. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
